Manage numbers inside a powerpack

Usage:
  plivo messaging sms powerpacks numbers [flags]
  plivo messaging sms powerpacks numbers [command]

Aliases:
  numbers, number

Available Commands:
  add         Add a number to a powerpack
  list        List numbers attached to a powerpack
  remove      Remove a number from a powerpack (requires --yes)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for numbers

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo messaging sms powerpacks numbers [command] --help" for more information about a command.
